name: io.github.thyn-ai/algenta
title: Algenta — repository intelligence & decision engine
description: Give any AI assistant Algenta's engine over MCP: repository intelligence (snapshot, triage, query the dependency/risk graph, simulate a patch's blast radius, run a verified fix, apply as patch/branch/PR), decision primitives (plan, simulate, recommend, record outcomes), persisted agent runs, connectors, and simulations. Works in Cursor, Claude, Codex, Zed, and any MCP client over stdio.

environmentVariables.name: ALGENTA_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Your Algenta API key (get one with `algenta login`, or from the dashboard). Legacy DE_API_KEY is also accepted.

environmentVariables.name: ALGENTA_BASE_URL
environmentVariables.description: Algenta engine base URL. Cloud Managed default; set your own for self-hosted / air-gapped.
